findings.proposition: Interpret weak advocacy through NPS composition alongside renewal intent.
Recent unresolved service problems are associated with materially worse advocacy and renewal intent.
Legacy recent-contact customers have severe problems but limited population contribution.
Reliability, trust and support resolution are strong correlates, not established causal drivers.
Long-tenure weakness should be interpreted alongside legacy-plan concentration.
Weighted company results are primary where weighting changes estimates.
Support evidence applies only to recent contacts.
Premium unresolved-contact outcomes require small-base restraint.
No single correlated diagnostic is the uniquely causal NPS driver.
